title: Haptic feedback for mid-air buttons in VR, between subjects (WebXR app)
description: Suite 6's synthetic between-subjects study (36 invented people, 12 per design) with a runnable WebXR keypad: the app configuration types codes with every design. Real agent runs use Claude Code + the built-in WebXR runtime.

actions.name: press-key
actions.description: Press keypad keys with the index fingertip, one after another

params.keys: or several digits pressed in order, for example 7391

actions.name: confirm-code
actions.description: Press Enter: submits the code as typed on the panel; the next code appears

app.instructions: The keypad floats below eye level in front of you; the panel above it shows the 4-digit code and the digits typed so far. act press-key presses keys (key: one of 0-9 or delete; or keys: several digits in order); act confirm-code presses Enter. Each press replies with what the participant saw and what the vibrotactile ring did, in words, since you cannot feel it. look turns the head: polar 90 is level, the start view (about 127) looks down at the keypad.
